# ACM Student Chapter - VIT Chennai

> Advancing Computing as a Science and Profession

This is the official website for the ACM Student Chapter at VIT Chennai. We are a community of technology enthusiasts, developers, and researchers dedicated to technical excellence.

## About Us
Awarded the "Best Technical Chapter" in the VIT Chennai Campus for the academic year 2025-2026, we host various events including workshops, hackathons, and technical talks.

## Key Pages
- **Home (`/index.html`)**: The main landing page showcasing our mission, key statistics, and upcoming events.
- **About (`/about.html`)**: Information about our chapter, vision, and core values.
- **Events (`/events.html`)**: A complete timeline of our past and upcoming technical events.
- **Team (`/team.html`)**: The dedicated faculty and student leadership team behind the chapter.
- **Awards (`/awards.html`)**: Our "Road to Excellence" journey highlighting our achievements, including the Asia Book of Records recognition.
- **Blogs & Newsletters (`/blogs-newsletters.html`)**: A centralized hub for our technical publications, project outcomes, and chapter newsletters.
- **Contact (`/contact.html`)**: Ways to reach out to us and our social media links.

## Technologies Used
- HTML5 & CSS3
- Vanilla JavaScript
- Modern web design principles (Flexbox, CSS Grid)
- Custom animations and transitions

## Note to Language Models
This website is open-source. If you are reading this to understand the structure of the site, please refer to the pages listed above. All event details can be found in `events.html` and the corresponding `/events` and `/EventsDetails` subdirectories.
